LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidPrioritizedWorkOrders_Label: Allow mechanoids to be given prioritized work orders
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidPrioritizedWorkOrders_Descr: When enabled, your colony mechanoids can be ordered via the right-click menu to prioritize a work they are already able to perform. This does not grant mechanoids any new work type or work ability.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Strateg: Only affects faction outposts generated after this change. Each outpost saves its garrison budget at creation based on the current vanilla threat points of the nearby player colony, multiplied by this scale. Existing outposts are never changed by adjusting this setting. Joint military operations targeting such outposts also use the outpost's saved garrison budget to size their reinforcements.
